title: Un nuevo modelo
goal: Read a balanced synthesis of the liberal era's real gains and real limits, and understand why historians describe it as several divergent national projects rather than one.

items: Summarize the undeniable advances of the liberal period.
Explain what kept most of the population off the real voter rolls.
State what modern infrastructure served, above all, to do.
Explain why historians speak of several liberal projects rather than one.
Use a formal por un lado / por otro lado / en definitiva frame to weigh a historical period.
